Inspect the image and handle machine/stack registration, food, or form in workout-session. Keep the workout task open. Do not apply photo completion, offer completion buttons, create done activity blocks, or reply with a task completion line. Use the image to answer the current session request.
task.photo.hook.armed: Capture all facts first. [photo-done] Photo turn while tasks are open today: {rows}. The kit armed the evidence gate. Read any image evidence of today's activity by meaning; for exactly one grounded match, settle with task-done-today and --photo-evidence containing the observed evidence. Two or more matches -> task-open-today --photo --offer <id>. No match -> do not mention unrelated tasks (schedule-log reference/completion-chat.md). After capture, --record-evidence VERB:ID is also valid proof. DONE: reply only the completion line. ALREADY_DONE: no completion announcement; answer the photo about the activity. No fulfilled open match: check done rows, then if this is an activity today create task-add "<owner words>" <today> --at <evidence HH:MM> and settle it with the actual proof. Pure facts/plans/history do not create today activities. Keep all tool work silent; no progress messages or capture card.
task.photo.hook.done: [photo-activity] Already recorded activity rows: {rows}. Inspect the photo and answer its activity question (including an implicit question). No already-done message, completion line, completion buttons or duplicate activity. If task-done-today returns ALREADY_DONE, its empty reply means answer the photo, not silence.
task.photo.hook.no_tasks: [photo-done] No task or routine occurrence is open or done today. Capture every readable fact silently, then apply SETTLE ON EVIDENCE before replying: if this image establishes an activity today, run task-add "<activity in the owner's words>" <today> --at <HH:MM>, then task-done-today with grounded --photo-evidence or same-turn --record-evidence. This line already answers the open-task check: put the capture commands, task-add and task-done-today --photo-evidence in ONE Bash call (no task-open-today round). Use document/capture/EXIF time, then stated time, then message time; no invented duration. Pure facts, plans and historical evidence create no today activity. A saved record/card alone does not replace the activity block. Write no text before or between tool calls (each text block is sent to the owner as its own message); adding the block is not a decision to announce. Reply only the completion line; no save question.

💰 Start your ledger ✍️ Record from today
• Recording: log income and spending. This is included by default.
📊 Past cash flow
• History: compare monthly income and money out, and see where it went.
🎯 Plan ahead
• Planning: work on spending less, saving, or repaying debt.
🔗 Connect shopping and payments to other areas
• Settlements: I split costs equally among the people who joined your plans, checking payments across a second venue too before settling up • Inventory: Items bought through shopping payments are automatically added to your home inventory • Contracts: I link contracts to fixed costs once their fees and billing cycles are confirmed
